items.title: Baby Bat Yawning
items.alt: A small fluffy-looking bat sits upright on a smooth pebble with eyes squeezed shut in a wide yawn, wings drooping gently to the sides.
items.description: A small fluffy-looking bat sits upright on a smooth pebble with eyes squeezed shut in a wide yawn, wings drooping gently to the sides. Useful for emotion and routine cards.
